page.layout: Running head at top: "DE HOMINIS LIBERAT." left, page number "559" right. Below it, centred: "DE BAPTISMO." One column of text. A woodcut ornamental initial (Q) with a frame stands at the upper left, beside the opening list of questions. Numbered question list 1-8 in italic below the intro line. Heading "I. Quid sit Baptismus." centred. Two paragraphs of running text below it. Catchword "externum" at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: 2. Qui sint fines Baptismi: seu, ad

l.i: Baptismus est externum lauacrum institutum à Filio dei
cum pronunciatione verborum, Baptizo te in nomine Pa-
tris & Filij & Spiritus sancti, ut sit testimonium eum qui sic
mergitur vel tingitur reconciliari propter Christum per fidem,

main_text.l: & sanctificari à Spiritu ad vitam æternam. Profecti (inquit
Christus) docete omnes gentes, Baptizantes eos in nomine Pa-
tris, Filij, & Spiritus Sancti. Commodè definiri potest
& hoc modo, Baptismus est ceremonia instituta à Christo in

l.i: novo Testamento, qua abluimur aqua in nomine Patris, Filij,
& Spiritus Sancti, ad significandum nos recipi in gratiam pro-
pter effusum pro nobis sanguinem Christi, & regenerari ipsius
Spiritu, & ad obligandos nos ut velimus deinceps factis

main_text.l: & reipsa testari novitatem vitæ. Dicimur in gratiam recipi
propter sanguinem Christi pro nobis effusum, scilicet
in cruce, id est, propter totam humiliationem Christi

l.i: Ob. Baptismus dicitur externum aquæ lauacrum. Ergo

main_text.l: Baptismus tantum est nudum signum. Resp. Est fallacia
divisionis, Quia cum dicimus baptismum esse signum

page.notes: Woodcut frame with a large Q at the upper left; it is the initial of "Quæstiones", so the word is written whole. The printed first word reads "Vęstiones", which is the same word with the woodcut letter missing. The word "quidab" in item 8 appears printed without a space; kept as seen, but the spacing is uncertain. The heading "I. Quid sit Baptismus." is treated as a level 2 heading inside the division. Decorative dots and marks in the right margin are not text. The line break in "Bap-tismo" and "Instituti-onis" is taken from the printed hyphens.
